title: Stop manually copying Zoho CRM and Books data to Excel! #Shorts
description:
Stop wasting time with spreadsheets. Learn how to use Zoho Analytics Data Sync to merge Zoho CRM and Books data into one real-time customer profitability dashboard.

1. Go to Zoho Analytics and click 'Import Data'
2. Select 'Zoho CRM' and 'Zoho Books' as sources
3. Create a 'Query Table' to join Sales and Finance data by Customer ID

Daily Zoho fixes - follow @GSXAutomation

Question that inspired this: https://www.reddit.com/r/Zoho/comments/1wyufsg/are_you_still_using_spreadsheets_for_reporting/

This video uses an AI-generated presenter and voice.

story.title: Are you still using spreadsheets for reporting despite having Zoho Analytics?
story.summary: Most businesses don’t have a data problem. They have a visibility problem. Sales data is in CRM. Financial data is in Books. Support data is in Desk. Project data is somewhere else. The information exists, but getting a clear picture of what is actually happening across the business can still be difficult. That’s where Zoho Analytics can make a real difference. With the right dashboards and data model, businesses can bring information together to: • Track the KPIs that actually matter • Understand sales and revenue trends • Compare performance across teams and regions • Identify problems before they become bigger • Replace repetitive spreadsheet reporting • Give management one clear view of the business But good analytics isn’t about creating more charts. It’s about turning business data into better decisions. At CRMFolks , we help businesses design Zoho Analytics around their actual pro

script.title: Stop manually copying Zoho CRM and Books data to Excel!

lines.say: Stop manually copying data from CRM to Excel for your reports!
lines.tts: Stop manually copying data from CRM to Excel for your reports!

lines.say: Scattered data silos between Zoho CRM, Zoho Books, and Zoho Desk make daily business reporting an absolute nightmare.
lines.tts: Scattered data silos between Zoho CRM, Zoho Books, and Zoho Desk make daily business reporting an absolute nightmare.

lines.say: Instead, use Zoho Analytics Data Sync to effortlessly merge all your connected modules into one unified dashboard.
lines.tts: Instead, use Zoho Analytics Data Sync to effortlessly merge all your connected modules into one unified dashboard.

lines.say: First, open your Zoho Analytics workspace and click on the Import Data button located at the top right.
lines.tts: First, open your Zoho Analytics workspace and click on the Import Data button located at the top right.

screen.heading: Workspace Explorer
screen.tip: Select Import Data from top right.

lines.say: Next, select both Zoho CRM and Zoho Books as your data sources from the connector options menu.
lines.tts: Next, select both Zoho CRM and Zoho Books as your data sources from the connector options menu.

lines.say: Then, create a Query Table to easily join your Sales and Finance data together using the Customer ID field.
lines.tts: Then, create a Query Table to easily join your Sales and Finance data together using the Customer ID field.

screen.heading: New Query Table
fields: SELECT * FROM Deals JOIN Invoices ON Deals.CustID = Invoices.CustID

lines.say: Finally, you get a single real-time dashboard showing true profitability per customer without manual effort.
lines.tts: Finally, you get a single real-time dashboard showing true profitability per customer without manual effort.

test_before_recording: Ensure Admin access to Zoho Analytics
